How to Keep Your Instagram Outreach DMs Out of Message Requests and Spam

Why Instagram outreach DMs get filtered or ignored, and 9 practical fixes to keep your cold messages visible and getting replies.

By ColdNerd Team · October 26, 2026 · 2 min read

Cold DMs from accounts a person does not follow land in Message Requests by default, and some are moved to the hidden requests folder. You cannot fully avoid this, but you can make your messages far more likely to be seen and opened. For the full process, see our Instagram outreach guide.

Why outreach DMs get filtered

  • The account is new, has few posts, or looks incomplete.

  • Many near-identical messages are sent in a short time.

  • The first message contains links, prices or salesy phrases.

  • Recipients ignore, delete or report your messages.

9 ways to stay visible

  1. Complete your profile: clear photo, bio, link and at least 9 quality posts.

  2. Warm up new accounts slowly before running outreach.

  3. Engage first: like or comment on a recent post before you message.

  4. Personalise the opening line so every message is unique.

  5. Leave links out of the first message; share them after a reply.

  6. Keep the first message short, ideally under 60 words.

  7. Spread sends across the day instead of sending in bursts.

  8. Stop messaging anyone who does not reply after one or two follow-ups.

  9. Watch your reply and block rates; if they drop, pause and fix your targeting or copy.

What to do if your account gets restricted

Stop all outreach for the restriction period, keep using the account normally, and restart at a lower volume with a better-targeted list.
